_readme: Bedside question set: real questions asked the way they are asked on shift. Scored by scripts/verify/bedside-score.mjs.
q        the question, verbatim, messy and abbreviated is the point. NO patient identifiers.
expect   pin keys, any one at rank N counts (same format as scripts/search-heldout.ts: tree:<id>, node:<tree>/<node>, info:<id>, sec:<page>#<anchor>, drug:<id>, calc:<id>).
answer   optional. Regex sources (case-insensitive); ALL must match the first result's preview for 'answer visible without a tap' to count.
covered  false = the app has no answer; the right behaviour is to say so, not guess. Leave expect empty.
pending  true = page not yet confirmed. Not scored; --propose prints the top 3 so the pin can be confirmed.
Never tune synonyms or boosts against a question here; fix the general rule that failed, or leave it failing and report it.

questions.q: what is max dose of lidocaine in doing awake intubation

questions.q: I have post exposure prophylaxis patient, what is cheapest treatment regimen
questions.note: Andy: the 28-Day Regimen node is the answer; the alternative (TDF/FTC + dolutegravir) is the cheaper regimen and the one used at Dell Seton. The app has no cost wording anywhere, so the node alone does not say which is cheaper (content idea for Andy, not a search fix).
